has_entitlement, expires_at, grace_expires_at, canceled_at,\n      billing_issue_at, revoked_at, expiration_confirmed_at, clocks, last_event_ms, last_reconciled_at, needs_reconcile)\n    VALUES (\n (p_fields->>'expires_at')::timestamptz, (p_fields->>'grace_expires_at')::timestamptz, (p_fields->>'canceled_at')::timestamptz,\n      (p_fields->>'billing_issue_at')::timestamptz, RETURN jsonb_build_object('applied', v_rows = 1, 'version', CASE WHEN v_rows = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END);\n  END IF;\n  UPDATE public.premium_entitlements SET\n    source = p_fields->>'source', expires_at = (p_fields->>'expires_at')::timestamptz, grace_expires_at = (p_fields->>'grace_expires_at')::timestamptz,\n    canceled_at = (p_fields->>'canceled_at')::timestamptz, billing_issue_at = public"],"owner":"postgres","proacl":"{postgres=X/postgres,service_role=X/postgres}","definition_md5":"7e9dd284c8a09c6b4ead586f4b0e7f0d","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.premium_authorize(p_account uuid, p_feature text, p_household uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_request_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_app_version text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_units integer DEFAULT 1, p_complete_now boolean DEFAULT false)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_now      timestamptz := clock_timestamp();\n  cfg        public.premium_feature_config%ROWTYPE;\n  rt         public.premium_runtime_config%ROWTYPE;\n  ev         public.premium_usage_events%ROWTYPE;\n  v_state    text := 'unknown';\n  v_reason   text := NULL;\n  v_next     text := 'none';\n  v_checks   jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_entitled boolean := false;\n  v_via      text := NULL;\n  v_limit    integer;\n  v_period   date;\n  v_end      date;\n  v_cost     integer;\n  v_claim    uuid := NULL;\n  v_reclaimed boolean := false;\n  v_replay   boolean := false;\n  v_used     integer := 0;\n  v_reserved integer := 0;\n  v_rows     integer;\n  v_recent   integer;\n  v_quota    jsonb := NULL;\n  v_audit    uuid := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_consent  boolean;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO rt FROM public.premium_runtime_config WHERE singleton;\n  SELECT * INTO cfg FROM public.premium_feature_config WHERE feature_key = p_feature;\n\n  <<decide>>\n  BEGIN\n    -- 0. request shape\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      v_reason := 'feature_disabled'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('feature_exists', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR length(p_idempotency_key) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 128\n       OR p_units IS NULL OR p_units < 1 OR p_units > cfg.max_units_per_request THEN\n      v_reason := 'invalid_request'; EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- 2. account lifecycle (identity was verified by the Edge Function; the account id is the JWT subject)\n    IF public.premium_account_lifecycle(p_account) <> 'active' THEN\n      v_state := CASE WHEN public.premium_account_lifecycle(p_account) = 'deletion_pending' THEN 'deletion_pending' ELSE 'unknown' END;\n      v_reason := 'account_deactivated'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('lifecycle', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('lifecycle', true);\n    v_state := public.premium_entitlement_state(p_account, v_now);\n\n    -- 3. ownership: a household id the client supplies never overrides server-verified membership\n    IF cfg.scope = 'household' AND p_household IS NULL THEN\n      v_reason := 'ownership_denied'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('ownership', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    IF p_household IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM public.household_members m\n      WHERE m.household_id = p_household AND m.profile_id = p_account AND m.member_type = 'adult') THEN\n      v_reason := 'ownership_denied'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('ownership', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('ownership', true);\n\n    -- 4. feature enabled, released, not killed, app version\n    IF NOT cfg.enabled OR NOT cfg.released OR cfg.kill_switch THEN\n      v_reason := 'feature_disabled'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('feature_enabled', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    IF NOT public.premium_version_gte(p_app_version, cfg.min_app_version) THEN\n      v_reason := 'feature_disabled'; v_next := 'update_app'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('app_version', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('feature_enabled', true);\n\n    -- 5. backend operational readiness\n    IF NOT rt.premium_enabled THEN\n      v_reason := 'service_unavailable'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('ready', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- Staging-only, server-enforced tester membership. Auth app metadata is writable\n    -- ONLY via the Supabase Admin API, never the account's raw_user_meta_data.\n    -- This is NOT a paid entitlement. A tester still needs a genuine provider\n    -- reconciliation for Premium to authorize a paid operation.\n    IF rt.environment = 'staging' AND cfg.tier = 'premium' AND cfg.rollout_status = 'staging_only' THEN\n      IF NOT EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id = p_account\n        AND u.raw_app_meta_data->>'herkeys_premium_tester' = 'true'\n      ) THEN\n        v_reason := 'feature_disabled';\n        v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('staging_allowlist', false);\n        EXIT decide;\n      END IF;\n      v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('staging_allowlist', true);\n    END IF;\n\n    -- 6. entitlement, or an APPROVED free allowance. Premium state is never inferred from anything but the projection.\n    v_entitled := v_state IN ('premium_active', 'premium_canceled_active', 'premium_billing_grace');\n    IF cfg.tier = 'free' THEN\n      v_via := 'free';\n    ELSIF v_entitled THEN\n      v_via := 'premium';\n    ELSIF cfg.free_allowance_status = 'approved' AND cfg.free_allowance > 0 AND v_state IN ('free', 'unknown', 'premium_expired', 'premium_revoked') THEN\n      v_via := 'free_allowance';\n    ELSE\n      v_reason := CASE v_state\n        WHEN 'unknown' THEN 'entitlement_unknown'\n        WHEN 'premium_expired' THEN 'entitlement_expired'\n        WHEN 'premium_revoked' THEN 'entitlement_expired'\n        ELSE 'requires_premium' END;\n      v_next := CASE v_state WHEN 'unknown' THEN 'retry_verification' ELSE 'open_paywall' END;\n      v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('entitlement', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n    v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('entitlement', true, 'via', v_via);\n\n    -- 7. AI consent (only where an external AI provider would see her content)\n    IF cfg.requires_ai_consent THEN\n      SELECT (c.policy_version = rt.ai_policy_version AND c.granted) INTO v_consent\n        FROM public.account_consents c WHERE c.account_id = p_account AND c.consent_type = 'ai_processing'\n        ORDER BY c.recorded_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 1;\n      IF v_consent IS NOT TRUE THEN\n        v_reason := 'requires_ai_consent'; v_next := 'grant_ai_consent'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('ai_consent', false); EXIT decide;\n      END IF;\n      v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('ai_consent', true);\n    END IF;\n\n    -- 8. quota and cost budget (atomic reservation)\n    v_period := public.premium_period_start(cfg.quota_period, v_now);\n    v_end := public.premium_period_end(cfg.quota_period, v_period);\n    v_cost := cfg.cost_weight * p_units;\n    v_limit := CASE v_via WHEN 'premium' THEN cfg.premium_limit WHEN 'free_allowance' THEN cfg.free_allowance ELSE NULL END;\n    IF cfg.quota_period = 'none' THEN v_limit := NULL; END IF;\n\n    PERFORM public.premium_expire_stale(p_account, p_feature);\n\n    -- claim the idempotency key first, so a concurrent duplicate waits on this row instead of double-charging\n    INSERT INTO public.premium_usage_events (account_id, feature_key, idempotency_key, status, units, cost_units, via, period_start)\n      VALUES (p_account, p_feature, p_idempotency_key, 'pending', p_units, v_cost, v_via, v_period)\n      ON CONFLICT (account_id, feature_key, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING\n      RETURNING id INTO v_claim;\n    IF v_claim IS NULL THEN\n      SELECT * INTO ev FROM public.premium_usage_events\n        WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key FOR UPDATE;\n      IF ev.status IN ('reserved', 'completed') THEN\n        v_replay := true; v_period := ev.period_start; v_via := ev.via;\n        v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('idempotent_replay', true);\n        EXIT decide;\n      END IF;\n      -- failed / expired / rejected: the same operation may be retried under the same key\n      UPDATE public.premium_usage_events SET status = 'pending', units = p_units, cost_units = v_cost, via = v_via,\n        period_start = v_period, created_at = v_now, completed_at = NULL WHERE id = ev.id;\n      v_claim := ev.id; v_reclaimed := true;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- per-account rate limit\n    SELECT count(*) INTO v_recent FROM public.premium_usage_events\n      WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND created_at >= v_now - INTERVAL '1 minute' AND id <> v_claim;\n    IF v_recent >= cfg.rate_limit_per_minute THEN\n      v_reason := 'rate_limited'; v_next := 'retry_later'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('rate', false); EXIT decide;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- per-account counter: ONE conditional UPDATE under the row lock is the whole race defence\n    IF v_limit IS NOT NULL THEN\n      INSERT INTO public.premium_usage (account_id, feature_key, period_start) VALUES (p_account, p_feature, v_period)\n        ON CONFLICT (account_id, feature_key, period_start) DO NOTHING;\n      IF p_complete_now THEN\n        UPDATE public.premium_usage SET used = used + p_units, updated_at = now()\n          WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND period_start = v_period AND used + reserved + p_units <= v_limit;\n      ELSE\n        UPDATE public.premium_usage SET reserved = reserved + p_units, updated_at = now()\n          WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND period_start = v_period AND used + reserved + p_units <= v_limit;\n      END IF;\n      GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;\n      IF v_rows = 0 THEN\n        v_reason := 'quota_exhausted'; v_next := CASE v_via WHEN 'free_allowance' THEN 'open_paywall' ELSE 'wait_for_reset' END;\n        v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('quota', false); EXIT decide;\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- global daily cost cap (compensates the per-account reservation on refusal)\n    IF cfg.global_daily_cost_cap IS NOT NULL THEN\n      INSERT INTO public.premium_usage_global (feature_key, day) VALUES (p_feature, (v_now AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date)\n        ON CONFLICT (feature_key, day) DO NOTHING;\n      UPDATE public.premium_usage_global SET cost_units = cost_units + v_cost\n        WHERE feature_key = p_feature AND day = (v_now AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND cost_units + v_cost <= cfg.global_daily_cost_cap;\n      GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;\n      IF v_rows = 0 THEN\n        IF v_limit IS NOT NULL THEN\n          IF p_complete_now THEN\n            UPDATE public.premium_usage SET used = GREATEST(used - p_units, 0) WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND period_start = v_period;\n          ELSE\n            UPDATE public.premium_usage SET reserved = GREATEST(reserved - p_units, 0) WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND period_start = v_period;\n          END IF;\n        END IF;\n        v_reason := 'quota_exhausted'; v_next := 'wait_for_reset'; v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('budget', false); EXIT decide;\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n\n    UPDATE public.premium_usage_events SET status = CASE WHEN p_complete_now THEN 'completed' ELSE 'reserved' END,\n      completed_at = CASE WHEN p_complete_now THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END WHERE id = v_claim;\n    v_checks := v_checks || jsonb_build_object('quota', true);\n  END decide;\n\n  -- Refusal after claiming a key: a fresh claim is removed, a reclaimed one goes back to `rejected`.\n  IF v_reason IS NOT NULL AND v_claim IS NOT NULL THEN\n    IF v_reclaimed THEN UPDATE public.premium_usage_events SET status = 'rejected', completed_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = v_claim;\n    ELSE DELETE FROM public.premium_usage_events WHERE id = v_claim AND status = 'pending'; END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- quota snapshot for the response (never content)\n  IF cfg.feature_key IS NOT NULL AND cfg.quota_period <> 'none' THEN\n    SELECT COALESCE(u.used, 0), COALESCE(u.reserved, 0) INTO v_used, v_reserved FROM (SELECT 1) s\n      LEFT JOIN public.premium_usage u ON u.account_id = p_account AND u.feature_key = p_feature AND u.period_start = public.premium_period_start(cfg.quota_period, v_now);\n    v_limit := CASE WHEN v_via = 'free_allowance' THEN cfg.free_allowance WHEN v_via = 'premium' THEN cfg.premium_limit\n                    ELSE COALESCE(CASE WHEN v_entitled THEN cfg.premium_limit END, NULLIF(cfg.free_allowance, 0)) END;\n    v_period := public.premium_period_start(cfg.quota_period, v_now);\n    v_quota := jsonb_build_object(\n      'period', cfg.quota_period, 'periodStart', v_period, 'periodEnd', public.premium_period_end(cfg.quota_period, v_period),\n      'used', v_used, 'reserved', v_reserved, 'limit', v_limit,\n      'remaining', CASE WHEN v_limit IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(v_limit - v_used - v_reserved, 0) END);\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_account IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth.users WHERE id = p_account) THEN\n    INSERT INTO public.premium_authorization_audit (id, account_id, feature_key, outcome, reason, entitlement_state, checks, request_id)\n      VALUES (v_audit, p_account, left(COALESCE(p_feature, ''), 64), CASE WHEN v_reason IS NULL THEN 'allowed' ELSE 'denied' END,\n              COALESCE(v_reason, 'allowed'), v_state, v_checks, left(p_request_id, 80));\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'outcome', CASE WHEN v_reason IS NULL THEN 'allowed' ELSE 'denied' END,\n    'reason', COALESCE(v_reason, 'allowed'),\n    'entitlementState', v_state,\n    'via', v_via,\n    'nextAction', CASE WHEN v_reason IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE v_next END,\n    'quota', v_quota,\n    'decisionId', v_audit,\n    'replay', v_replay);\nEND\n$function$\n"},{"schema":"public","proname":"premium_complete_usage","args":"p_account uuid, p_feature text, p_idempotency_key text","prosecdef":true,"proconfig":["search_path=pg_catalog, public"],"owner":"postgres","proacl":"{postgres=X/postgres,service_role=X/postgres}","definition_md5":"310a9ffd5fd4356b1d7051aa423b7cfd","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.premium_complete_usage(p_account uuid, p_feature text, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE ev public.premium_usage_events%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO ev FROM public.premium_usage_events\n    WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN 'missing'; END IF;\n  IF ev.status = 'completed' THEN RETURN 'completed'; END IF;\n  IF ev.status <> 'reserved' THEN RETURN ev.status; END IF;\n  UPDATE public.premium_usage_events SET status = 'completed', completed_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = ev.id;\n  UPDATE public.premium_usage SET used = used + ev.units, reserved = GREATEST(reserved - ev.units, 0), updated_at = now()\n    WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND period_start = ev.period_start;\n  RETURN 'completed';\nEND\n$function$\n"},{"schema":"public","proname":"premium_decision_may_transition","args":"p_from text, p_to text","prosecdef":false,"proconfig":["search_path=pg_catalog"],"owner":"postgres","proacl":"{postgres=X/postgres,service_role=X/postgres}","definition_md5":"7216152d0f36a70561ebe074162a87f6","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.premium_decision_may_transition(p_from text, p_to text)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT (p_from, p_to) IN (\n    ('proposed', 'approved'), ('proposed', 'rejected'), ('proposed', 'abandoned'),\n    ('approved', 'applying'), ('approved', 'applied'), ('approved', 'failed'), ('approved', 'abandoned'),\n    ('applying', 'applied'), ('applying', 'failed'), ('applying', 'abandoned'),\n    ('applied', 'reverted'), ('applied', 'revert_blocked'),\n    ('revert_blocked', 'reverted'), ('revert_blocked', 'applied'),\n    ('failed', 'approved'), ('failed', 'abandoned'))\n$function$\n"},{"schema":"public","proname":"premium_decision_record","args":"p_household uuid, p_feature text, p_kind text, p_idempotency_key text, p_proposal_ref jsonb, p_proposal_digest text, p_source_ref jsonb, p_before jsonb, p_planned jsonb, p_inverse jsonb","prosecdef":true,"proconfig":["search_path=pg_catalog, public"],"owner":"postgres","proacl":"{postgres=X/postgres,service_role=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres}","definition_md5":"76caa38a542469846c68e3e417cfec92","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.premium_decision_record(p_household uuid, p_feature text, p_kind text, p_idempotency_key text, p_proposal_ref jsonb, p_proposal_digest text, p_source_ref jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_before jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_planned jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_inverse jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)\n RETURNS premium_decisions\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_account uuid := auth.uid(); v_row public.premium_decisions;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_account IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '28000'; END IF;\n  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_members m WHERE m.household_id = p_household AND m.profile_id = v_account AND m.member_type = 'adult') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ownership_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';\n  END IF;\n  -- The key must be an operation the SERVER authorized — exactly, or DERIVED from one as \"<authorized key>:<suffix>\" (one authorized\n  -- review covers the decisions made under it: approve, reject, retry). A key that merely looks similar is not enough.\n  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.premium_usage_events e\n                  WHERE e.account_id = v_account AND e.feature_key = p_feature AND e.status IN ('reserved', 'completed')\n                    AND (e.idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key\n                         OR left(p_idempotency_key, length(e.idempotency_key) + 1) = e.idempotency_key || ':')) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.premium_decisions (account_id, household_id, feature_key, kind, idempotency_key, proposal_ref, source_ref,\n                                        proposal_digest, before_snapshot, planned_snapshot, inverse)\n  VALUES (v_account, p_household, p_feature, p_kind, p_idempotency_key, p_proposal_ref, p_source_ref, p_proposal_digest, p_before, p_planned, p_inverse)\n  ON CONFLICT (account_id, feature_key, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING\n  RETURNING * INTO v_row;\n  IF v_row.id IS NULL THEN\n    SELECT * INTO v_row FROM public.premium_decisions WHERE account_id = v_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key;\n    -- a replay of the SAME operation returns the same receipt; a key reused for a different proposal is refused, never merged\n    IF v_row.proposal_digest <> p_proposal_digest OR v_row.household_id <> p_household THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'idempotency_conflict' USING ERRCODE = '23505'; END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_row;\nEND\n$function$\n"},{"schema":"public","proname":"premium_decision_transition","args":"p_id uuid, FUNCTION public.premium_decision_transition(p_id uuid, p_to text, p_patch jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)\n RETURNS premium_decisions\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_account uuid := auth.uid(); v_row public.premium_decisions; v_key text; v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();\nBEGIN\n  IF v_account IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '28000'; END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO v_row FROM public.premium_decisions WHERE id = p_id AND account_id = v_account FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;\n  FOR v_key IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(p_patch) LOOP\n    IF v_key NOT IN ('after_snapshot', 'planned_snapshot', 'result_ref', 'failure_code', 'corrected') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'patch_key_not_allowed' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  -- the same transition retried is a no-op (a flaky network must not turn a success into an error)\n  IF v_row.status = p_to THEN RETURN v_row; END IF;\n  IF NOT public.premium_decision_may_transition(v_row.status, p_to) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'illegal_transition:%->%', v_row.status, p_to USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.premium_decisions SET\n    status = p_to,\n    corrected = COALESCE((p_patch->>'corrected')::boolean, corrected),\n    planned_snapshot = COALESCE(p_patch->'planned_snapshot', planned_snapshot),\n    after_snapshot = COALESCE(p_patch->'after_snapshot', after_snapshot),\n    result_ref = COALESCE(p_patch->'result_ref', result_ref),\n    failure_code = CASE WHEN p_to IN ('failed', 'revert_blocked', 'abandoned') THEN p_patch->>'failure_code' ELSE NULL END,\n    decided_at = CASE WHEN p_to IN ('approved', 'rejected') THEN v_now ELSE decided_at END,\n    applied_at = CASE WHEN p_to = 'applied' THEN COALESCE(applied_at, v_now) ELSE applied_at END,\n    reverted_at = CASE WHEN p_to = 'reverted' THEN v_now ELSE reverted_at END,\n    updated_at = v_now\n  WHERE id = p_id RETURNING * INTO v_row;\n  RETURN v_row;\nEND\n$function$\n"},{"schema":"public","proname":"premium_derive_state","args":"p_exists boolean, p_canceled_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'premium_canceled_active' ELSE 'premium_active' END\n    WHEN p_grace_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND p_now <= p_grace_expires_at THEN 'premium_billing_grace'\n    WHEN public.premium_entitlement_state(p_account uuid, p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT clock_timestamp())\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  e public.premium_entitlements%ROWTYPE;\n  rt public.premium_runtime_config%ROWTYPE;\n  v_found boolean;\nBEGIN\n  IF public.premium_account_lifecycle(p_account) = 'deletion_pending' THEN\n    RETURN 'deletion_pending';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO rt FROM public.premium_runtime_config WHERE singleton;\n  SELECT * INTO e FROM public.premium_entitlements WHERE account_id = p_account;\n  v_found := FOUND;\n\n  -- Previously this flag did not participate in the Premium state. When a\n  -- transfer, webhook failure, or conflicting event requires reconciliation,\n  -- the last active state MUST NOT continue to grant expensive operations.\n  -- The existing premium-gate can attempt bounded provider reconciliation\n  -- after receiving entitlement_unknown; a failed provider lookup stays denied.\n  IF v_found AND e.needs_reconcile THEN\n    RETURN 'unknown';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- A signed webhook is lifecycle evidence, but does not replace an actual\n  -- subscriber read with the server secret key. Treat old, absent or\n  -- suspiciously future reconciliation timestamps as UNKNOWN for accounts\n  -- that might otherwise receive paid authorization. The generic gate\n  -- already performs one bounded reconcile on entitlement_unknown.\n  IF v_found AND e.has_entitlement AND e.source <> 'test_fixture' AND (\n    e.last_reconciled_at IS NULL\n    OR e.last_reconciled_at < p_now - make_interval(secs => rt.max_reconciled_age_seconds)\n    OR e.last_reconciled_at > p_now + interval '5 minutes'\n  ) THEN\n    RETURN 'unknown';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN public.premium_derive_state(\n    v_found, e.source, e.has_entitlement, e.expires_at, e.grace_expires_at,\n    e.canceled_at, e.revoked_at, e.expiration_confirmed_at,\n    rt.allow_test_fixtures, p_now\n  );\nEND\n$function$\n"},{"schema":"public","proname":"premium_event_set_status","args":"p_id uuid, p_status text, p_account uuid, p_error 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_attempts integer; v_final text := p_status;\nBEGIN\n  UPDATE public.premium_events SET attempts = attempts + CASE WHEN p_status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\n    WHERE id = p_id RETURNING attempts INTO v_attempts;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN 'missing'; END IF;\n  IF p_status = 'failed' AND v_attempts >= 5 THEN v_final := 'dead_letter'; END IF;\n  UPDATE public.premium_events SET status = v_final, account_id = COALESCE(p_account, account_id),\n    last_error = left(p_error, 120),\n    processed_at = CASE WHEN v_final IN ('failed') THEN processed_at ELSE clock_timestamp() END\n    WHERE id = p_id;\n  IF v_final = 'dead_letter' AND p_account IS NOT NULL THEN\n    UPDATE public.premium_entitlements SET needs_reconcile = true, updated_at = now() WHERE account_id = p_account;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_final;\nEND\n$function$\n"},{"schema":"public","proname":"premium_expire_stale","args":"p_account uuid, p_feature text, public.premium_expire_stale(p_account uuid, p_feature text, p_minutes integer DEFAULT 15)\n RETURNS integer\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE r record; v_count integer := 0;\nBEGIN\n  FOR r IN\n    SELECT id, units, cost_units, period_start, created_at FROM public.premium_usage_events\n    WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND status = 'reserved'\n      AND created_at < clock_timestamp() - make_interval(mins => p_minutes)\n    FOR UPDATE\n  LOOP\n    UPDATE public.premium_usage_events SET status = 'expired', completed_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = r.id;\n    UPDATE public.premium_usage SET reserved = GREATEST(reserved - r.units, 0), updated_at = now()\n      WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND period_start = r.period_start;\n    UPDATE public.premium_usage_global SET cost_units = GREATEST(cost_units - r.cost_units, 0)\n      WHERE feature_key = p_feature AND day = (r.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date;\n    v_count := v_count + 1;\n  END LOOP;\n  RETURN v_count;\nEND\n$function$\n"},{"schema":"public","proname":"premium_fail_usage","args":"p_account uuid, p_feature text, p_idempotency_key text","prosecdef":true,"proconfig":["search_path=pg_catalog, ev.status; END IF;\n  UPDATE public.premium_usage_events SET status = 'failed', completed_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = ev.id;\n  UPDATE public.premium_usage SET reserved = GREATEST(reserved - ev.units, 0), updated_at = now()\n    WHERE account_id = p_account AND feature_key = p_feature AND period_start = ev.period_start;\n  UPDATE public.premium_usage_global SET cost_units = public.premium_health()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_dead integer; v_backlog_age numeric; v_backlog integer; v_reconcile integer; v_stale integer; v_failed_24h integer; v_fix integer;\n  v_rt public.premium_runtime_config%ROWTYPE; v_alerts jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO v_rt FROM public.premium_runtime_config WHERE singleton;\n  SELECT count(*) INTO v_dead FROM public.premium_events WHERE status = 'dead_letter';\n  SELECT count(*), COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (clock_timestamp() - min(received_at))), 0) INTO v_backlog, v_backlog_age FROM public.premium_events WHERE status IN ('received', 'failed');\n  SELECT count(*) INTO v_reconcile FROM public.premium_entitlements WHERE needs_reconcile;\n  SELECT count(*) INTO v_stale FROM public.premium_entitlements WHERE last_reconciled_at < clock_timestamp() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND expires_at > clock_timestamp();\n  SELECT count(*) INTO v_failed_24h FROM public.premium_decisions WHERE status IN ('failed', 'revert_blocked') AND updated_at > clock_timestamp() - INTERVAL '24 hours';\n  SELECT count(*) INTO v_fix FROM public.premium_entitlements WHERE source = 'test_fixture';\n\n  IF v_dead > 0 THEN v_alerts := v_alerts || jsonb_build_object('rule', 'dead_letter_events', 'severity', 'page', 'value', v_dead, 'threshold', 0); END IF;\n  IF v_backlog_age > 600 THEN v_alerts := v_alerts || jsonb_build_object('rule', 'webhook_backlog_age_seconds', 'severity', 'page', 'value', round(v_backlog_age), 'threshold', 600); END IF;\n  IF v_reconcile > 25 THEN v_alerts := v_alerts || jsonb_build_object('rule', 'accounts_needing_reconcile', 'severity', 'warn', 'value', v_reconcile, 'threshold', 25); END IF;\n  IF v_stale > 0 THEN v_alerts := v_alerts || jsonb_build_object('rule', 'paid_projection_not_reconciled_30d', 'severity', 'warn', 'value', v_stale, 'threshold', 0); END IF;\n  IF v_failed_24h > 10 THEN v_alerts := v_alerts || jsonb_build_object('rule', 'failed_or_blocked_decisions_24h', 'severity', 'warn', 'value', v_failed_24h, 'threshold', 10); END IF;\n  IF NOT v_rt.webhook_processing THEN v_alerts := v_alerts || jsonb_build_object('rule', 'webhook_processing_halted', 'severity', 'warn', 'value', 1, 'threshold', 0); END IF;\n  IF NOT v_rt.premium_enabled THEN v_alerts := v_alerts || jsonb_build_object('rule', 'premium_globally_disabled', 'severity', 'warn', 'value', 1, 'threshold', 0); END IF;\n  -- structural safety: a production database must never hold a fabricated entitlement\n  IF v_rt.environment = 'production' AND v_fix > 0 THEN v_alerts := v_alerts || jsonb_build_object('rule', 'test_fixture_entitlement_in_production', 'severity', 'page', 'value', v_fix, 'threshold', 0); END IF;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'environment', v_rt.environment, 'checkedAt', clock_timestamp(), 'ok', jsonb_array_length(v_alerts) = 0, 'alerts', v_alerts,\n    'counts', jsonb_build_object('deadLetter', v_dead, 'backlog', v_backlog, 'backlogAgeSeconds', round(v_backlog_age), 'needsReconcile', v_reconcile, 'staleProjections', v_stale, 'failedDecisions24h', v_failed_24h));\nEND\n$function$\n"},{"schema":"public","proname":"premium_my_entitlement","args":"","prosecdef":true,"proconfig":["search_path=pg_catalog, FUNCTION public.premium_purchase_readiness()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_account uuid := auth.uid();\n  v_runtime public.premium_runtime_config%ROWTYPE;\n  v_count integer;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_account IS NULL OR public.premium_account_lifecycle(v_account) <> 'active' THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready', false, 'reason', 'account_unavailable');\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_runtime FROM public.premium_runtime_config WHERE singleton;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_runtime.premium_enabled THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready', false, 'reason', 'premium_disabled');\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT v_runtime.webhook_processing THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready', false, 'reason', 'fulfillment_unavailable');\n  END IF;\n  -- Checkout is an INDEPENDENT commercial rollout. Enabling the application,\n  -- Premium features or subscription webhook fulfillment NEVER starts paid sales.\n  IF NOT v_runtime.checkout_enabled THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready', false, 'reason', 'checkout_disabled');\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT count(*) INTO v_count\n  FROM public.premium_feature_config\n  WHERE feature_key IN ('daily_load_premium', 'smart_inbox_extract', 'momentum_report')\n    AND tier = 'premium' AND enabled AND released AND NOT kill_switch\n    AND (\n      (v_runtime.environment = 'production' AND rollout_status = 'general' AND limit_status = 'owner_approved')\n      OR (v_runtime.environment = 'staging' AND rollout_status = 'staging_only')\n    );\n  IF v_count <> 3 THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready', false, 'reason', 'benefits_unavailable');\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_runtime.environment = 'staging' AND NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM auth.users\n    WHERE id = v_account\n      AND raw_app_meta_data->>'herkeys_premium_tester' = 'true'\n  ) THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready', false, 'reason', 'tester_not_eligible');\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ready', true, 'reason', 'ready');\nEND;\n$function$\n"},{"schema":"public","proname":"premium_reconcile_claim","args":"p_account uuid","prosecdef":true,"proconfig":["search_path=pg_catalog,
